Consider the following statements regarding Sher Shah's contribution to architecture:
(I) He built a famous mausoleum at Sasaram in Bihar.
(II) He built a mosque in the old fort at Delhi.
(III) His buildings mark the climax of Mughal architecture.
Which of the above is/are correct?
faqs.e: Sher Shah's works form the climax of pre-Mughal architecture and the starting point for the new Mughal style, not the climax of Mughal architecture itself.
